title: Simple Todo App
description: An application to manage and organize tasks efficiently.

features.name: Task Creation
features.description: Allows users to create new tasks with titles and descriptions.

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Enables users to edit, delete, and mark tasks as complete.

features.name: Task Organization
features.description: Provides options to categorize tasks and set priorities.

target_users: Individuals looking to manage personal or professional tasks
data_requirements: Requires storage for task details and user preferences
